basic_info.description: This updated, charming, and spacious house is move-in ready. Enjoy west-facing bedrooms with sunset views, and a balcony perfect for an herb garden just outside the formal dining room. The home boasts a remodeled large kitchen, a new fireplace, and refinished hardwood floors, all bathed in abundant natural light. With updated electrical and a clean, well-maintained yard, it truly has great bones. Downstairs, you'll find an extra-large permitted family room and a full bath. The backyard offers a naturally and visually appealing mix of plants.
